name: dsh-theme-admech
description: Pure Forge-Cathedral tech-gothic theme for DSH. v0.6.2: user-provided gear-skull standard (recolored + scaled), faceted gothic portal backdrop, angular shrine crest above the composer, cathedral-framed chat, provided emblem replacing the hero whale. 机械神教 · 铸炉圣殿 v0.4。 Windows font fallbacks added; not yet verified on a Windows machine. v0.4.2 fixes icon restoration when the plugin is disabled. v0.5.0 adds the Forge-Cathedral startup ignition splash. v0.5.1 fixes the composer unmount / removeChild crash after sending a message. v0.5.2 redesigns the deep-diving and conversation-process icons with Forge-Cathedral glyphs. v0.5.3 updates the startup title to 铸造圣殿. v0.6.0 redesigns changed-file/deliverable card frames and maps expanded ToolRow icons. v0.6.1 fixes blank file-card icons and maps expanded reasoning-row icons. v0.6.2 adds account/Platform dialog click and splash guards.
